cmd:
echo ===LOGSIZE===; wc -l /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===FIRST429TODAY===; grep -n "429" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep "^" | awk -F: '{print $1}' | head -1
echo ===GREP-10-09===; grep -B2 "429" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep -E "^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}" | head -5
echo ===ALL-429-COUNT===; grep -c "429" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===SUCCESS-AFTER-1300===; grep -E "\\[OK\\]|success|\u2713 icon_eu|\u2713 ecmwf" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | tail -5
echo ===LAST-SUCCESSFUL-MODEL-FETCH===; grep -E "HTTP Error 429|\u2717 |INFO.*ecmwf_ifs|INFO.*icon_eu" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep -v WARNING | tail -40
echo ===DISK===; df -h / | tail -1
echo ===UPTIME===; uptime
